description: IEEE Data Descriptions is a data journal published by IEEE (ISSN 2995-4274) that carries peer-reviewed data descriptors, each pointing to a data set held in a repository. This record stands for the journal as a source of data sets for infrastructure and hazard studies. The data harvest screened every paper of the journal in Crossref on 2026-10-01 and kept those about infrastructure, energy, transport, telecom, water, buildings and natural hazards; 21 of them are catalogued as their own records and are linked here. Coverage is worldwide and differs by data set. Access is through the publisher's website, free to read for open papers; the journal pages are not always reachable from the cloud, so some data links were taken from open metadata. Licence and cost differ per paper and per data set, and the descriptors do not state a common licence. Caveats: the journal covers all fields, so most papers are outside this catalogue's scope, and only the title and abstract of each paper were read. It can support literature-led discovery of new infrastructure data sets and benchmark data for simulation studies. Related records: the data set records catalogued from this journal.
